title: Swamp dragon transformation
summary: A dire leech reveals a swamp dragon when wounded.
overview: A dire leech reveals a swamp dragon when wounded.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Be ready to acquire the dragon as soon as the leech transforms.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 80% health the leech attempts to spawn the swamp dragon at its current position.
If that dragon is already present, the health trigger is rearmed instead.
The leech disappears when the transformation succeeds.

notes: Approval E329. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
